name: Fabric SQL | Public Preview | Extend Backup Retention Policy to 35 days
description: Backup retention policy is the capability to change the retention period which allows users to adjust the duration for which automated backups are maintained for a SQL database artifact. This feature directly affects point-in-time restore capability (specific period in which user can choose the specific point in time to restore their database to).

result.nameEs: Fabric SQL: retención de copias de seguridad ampliada a 35 días (Preview pública)
